items.headline: Tokenized Stocks Get Uniswap v4 Liquidity on $MON
items.summary: Monad announced 10 xStocks markets with live Uniswap v4 liquidity, bringing tokenized equities deeper into DeFi. Access limits and collateral-pricing rules still apply for builders.

items.headline: $ONDO Launches S&P 500 Token With Loss Buffers
items.summary: $ONDO's new SPYSHIELD token bundles exposure to 12 defined-protection ETFs for eligible non-US investors. Loss buffers depend on holding periods and exclude fees.

items.headline: Coinbase Expands Onchain Loans to NY via $MORPHO
items.summary: Coinbase brought its $MORPHO-powered onchain loan product to New York residents, supporting BTC, ETH and SOL as collateral. A big regulatory win for DeFi lending rails.

items.headline: $GRVT Debuts RWA Perps Tied to TradFi Funding
items.summary: $GRVT launched Stable Funding Perps across seven commodity markets, with funding rates linked to market makers' real financing costs. A fresh DeFi use case bridging traditional markets.

items.headline: CFTC Halts Kalshi Trump Word Bets for Review
items.summary: The CFTC ordered Kalshi to defend its Trump-word contracts by December 11 over manipulation concerns. Other mention markets remain listed on the prediction platform.
